english: First, I should hear both sides.

chinese: 你的书是这本还是那本？
pinyin: nǐ de shū shì zhè běn hái shi nà běn?
english: Which is your book, this one or that one?

pinyin: shēng huó de lè qù shì shén me?
english: What is the joy of life?

chinese: 你举了一个不好的例子。
pinyin: nǐ jǔ le yī gè bù hǎo de lì zi.
english: You gave a bad example.

pinyin: nǐ yǒng yuǎn bù huì yī gè rén de.
english: You'll never be alone.

chinese: 我们没有足够的时间了。
pinyin: wǒ men méi yǒu zú gòu de shí jiān le.
english: We just don't have enough time.

chinese: 我从英国订了好几本书。
pinyin: wǒ cóng yīng guó dìng le hǎo jǐ běn shū.
english: I ordered several books from England.

pinyin: nǐ néng gěi wǒ zhé kòu ma?
english: Can you give me a discount?

pinyin: nǐ de tóu tòng zhì hǎo le?
english: Is your headache gone?

chinese: 据说山上的天气变化很快。
pinyin: jù shuō shān shàng de tiān qì biàn huà hěn kuài.
english: It is said that the weather on the mountain changes easily.

pinyin: wǒ men xiū xi yī xià, hǎo ma?
english: Let's take a break, OK?

pinyin: nín zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma?
english: Are you ready?

pinyin: wǒ bù shì yī gè guài rén.
english: I'm not a weirdo.

chinese: 他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。
pinyin: tā bèi hěn duō rén wéi zhe, zì rán biàn de yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng.
english: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.

chinese: 没人知道那机器长什么样子。
pinyin: méi rén zhī dào nà jī qì zhǎng shén me yàng zi.
english: Nobody knew what the machine was like.

pinyin: tā hěn kuài jiù hǎo le.
english: He'll be done soon.

chinese: 请你帮我换一点零钱行吗？
pinyin: qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ huàn yī diǎn líng qián xíng ma?
english: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

pinyin: chū shén me shì le, bǎo bèi?
english: What's wrong, honey?

pinyin: tā tòu lù le wǒ de mì mì.
english: He disclosed my secret.

pinyin: tā jià gěi le yī gè yǒu qián rén.
english: She married a rich man.

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng chéng míng.
english: I don't want to be famous.

pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi tā hái xiǎng qǔ wǒ ma?
english: Do you think he still wants to marry me?

pinyin: nǐ yǒu zhè shān mén de yào shi ma?
english: Do you have the key to this door?

chinese: 你不明白。他会杀了你的。
pinyin: nǐ bù míng bai. tā huì shā le nǐ de.
english: You don't understand. He'll kill you.

pinyin: nǐ yǒu duō yú de yào shi ma?
english: Do you have an extra key?

pinyin: wǒ men jiāng yú xià zhōu rì jié hūn.
english: We are to be married next Sunday.

pinyin: xià yī zhàn shì shén me dì fang?
english: What's the next station?

pinyin: jīng dū yǒu hěn duō suǒ dà xué.
english: Kyoto has many universities.

chinese: 去那个村庄的唯一途径是过河。
pinyin: qù nèi ge cūn zhuāng de wéi yī tú jìng shì guò hé.
english: The only access to the village is from the river.

pinyin: shén me dòng wù shì zōng sè de?
english: What animal is brown?

pinyin: nǐ bù gāi xiāng xìn wǒ.
english: You shouldn't trust me.

chinese: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me lái ān wèi nǐ.
english: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

pinyin: dāi zài nà r bié dòng.
english: Remain there and don't move.

pinyin: wǒ gāi dài zài chuáng shàng ma?
english: Must I stay in bed?

chinese: 那么你下午到过几个地方？
pinyin: nà me nǐ xià wǔ dào guo jǐ ge dì fang?
english: So how many places have you been to in the afternoon?

chinese: 再走一步的话，你就已经跌下楼梯了。
pinyin: zài zǒu yī bù de huà, nǐ jiù yǐ jīng diē xià lóu tī le.
english: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.

pinyin: wǒ jiè le nǐ de zhěn tou.
english: I borrowed your pillow.

pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn.
english: I have no idea of what to do.

chinese: 在非洲有许多孩子死于饥饿。
pinyin: zài fēi zhōu yǒu xǔ duō hái zi sǐ yú jī è.
english: Many children die of starvation in Africa.

pinyin: wǒ bù gāi shuō nà ge.
english: I should not have said that.

pinyin: bié zhè yàng xià wǒ ba!
english: Don't scare me like that!

chinese: 您想听听这件事的真相吗？
pinyin: nín xiǎng tīng tīng zhè jiàn shì de zhēn xiàng ma?
english: Do you want to hear the truth about this matter?

pinyin: qǐng wèn zhè r shì shén me dì fang?
english: Pardon me, what place is this?

chinese: 如果你发现错误，那就请你纠正它。
pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ fā xiàn cuò wù, nà jiù qǐng nǐ jiū zhèng tā.
english: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.

chinese: 我会在这儿再待上三天。
pinyin: wǒ huì zài zhè r zài dài shàng sān tiān.
english: I'll be staying here for another three days.

pinyin: wǒ de hù zhào bèi rén tōu le.
english: My passport was stolen.

pinyin: kào! wǒ yǎo dào zì jǐ shé tou le.
english: Ouch! I bit my tongue.

chinese: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。
pinyin: wǒ bà ba xiàn zài fēi cháng zhuān zhù yú gǔ shì.
english: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.

chinese: 说句实话，他真的尽力了。
pinyin: shuō jù shí huà, tā zhēn de jìn lì le.
english: In all fairness, he did do his best.

pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng jiàn tā jiù huí tóu.
english: Turn back if you want to see her.

pinyin: tā suǒ shuō de yī qiè shì zhēn de.
english: All he said was true.

chinese: 嗯。。。我可以加入你的小组嘛
pinyin: ēn... wǒ kě yǐ jiā rù nǐ de xiǎo zǔ ma
english: Um... can we join your group?

chinese: 透过窗，我们可以看到很美的海景。
pinyin: tòu guò chuāng, wǒ men kě yǐ kàn dào hěn měi de hǎi jǐng.
english: We have a good view of the sea from the window.

pinyin: nǐ tīng guò zhè shǒu qǔ zi ma?
english: Have you listened to this song?

pinyin: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhù fú nǐ.
english: Best wishes from all of us.

pinyin: nǐ yǒng yuǎn dōu bù néng tài zì wǒ.
english: You can never have too much ego.

chinese: 你走了，我们都会想你的。
pinyin: nǐ zǒu le, wǒ men dōu huì xiǎng nǐ de.
english: We shall all miss you when you go away.

chinese: 有人死了的时候真是遗憾。
pinyin: yǒu rén sǐ le de shí hou zhēn shì yí hàn.
english: It's a pity when somebody dies.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ jiāo péng you.
english: I want to be friends with you.

pinyin: wǒ zhēn de hěn xiǎng biǎn yī gè rén.
english: I really need to hit somebody.

pinyin: bù yào chā shǒu wǒ de shì.
english: Don't interfere in my affairs.

chinese: 他看上去是个十足的绅士。
pinyin: tā kàn shang qu shì ge shí zú de shēn shì.
english: He looks every inch a gentleman.

chinese: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。
pinyin: zhè ge fàn zuì hé wǒ yī diǎn guān xi dōu méi yǒu.
english: I have nothing to do with the crime.

chinese: 他好心地把我送到医院。
pinyin: tā hǎo xīn de bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn.
english: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.

pinyin: wǒ men néng bù dǎ le ma?
english: Can we stop fighting?

chinese: 这种秘密总有一天会被揭露的。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng mì mì zǒng yǒu yī tiān huì bèi jiē lù de.
english: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.

chinese: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。
pinyin: wǒ bà ba nián qīng de shí hou yī dìng hěn yīng jùn.
english: My father must have been handsome in his youth.

chinese: 诚信是一种重要的美德。
pinyin: chéng xìn shì yī zhǒng zhòng yào de měi dé.
english: Honesty is a capital virtue.

pinyin: wǒ méi xiǎng dǎ tàn de.
english: I didn't mean to pry.

pinyin: tā shì wǒ de péng you zhī yī.
english: He's one of my friends.

pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì mán zhe wǒ shén me?
english: Are you hiding something?

chinese: 他在哪里买的这个吉他？
pinyin: tā zài nǎ lǐ mǎi de zhè ge jí tā?
english: Where did he buy this guitar?

chinese: 你可以骑上我的摩托车去遛一圈。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ qí shàng wǒ de mó tuō chē qù liù yī quān.
english: You can have a ride on my motorcycle.

pinyin: nǐ hé wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn ān quán.
english: You're safe here with me.

pinyin: wǒ zài yě bù hé tā shuō huà le.
english: I don't talk to him anymore.

pinyin: nǐ zhēn shi gè dà hǎo rén!
english: You're really a great person.

pinyin: tā de zhèng quán bì dìng huì bēng kuì.
english: His regime is bound to collapse.

chinese: 这些书和衣服都是你的。
pinyin: zhè xiē shū hé yī fu dōu shì nǐ de.
english: These books and clothes are all yours.

chinese: 你们这些家伙去哪儿了？
pinyin: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo qù nǎ r le?
english: Where did you guys go?

pinyin: zhè jiàn shì tā míng jì yú xīn.
english: The incident was etched in his memory.

chinese: 你不能指望他们的帮助。
pinyin: nǐ bù néng zhǐ wàng tā men de bāng zhù.
english: You can't count on their help.

chinese: 我对你的厚颜无耻感到惊讶。
pinyin: wǒ duì nǐ de hòu yán wú chǐ gǎn dào jīng yà.
english: I'm amazed at your audacity.

chinese: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？
pinyin: nǐ zài diàn shì shàng kàn zú qiú sài le ma?
english: Did you watch the soccer game on television?

chinese: 今晚你可以在他家联络到他。
pinyin: jīn wǎn nǐ kě yǐ zài tā jiā lián luò dào tā.
english: You can get in touch with him at his home tonight.

chinese: 世界就是一个疯子的囚笼。
pinyin: shì jiè jiù shì yī gè fēng zi de qiú lóng.
english: The world is a den of crazies.

pinyin: wǒ de zì xíng chē huài le.
english: My bike is broken.

pinyin: wǒ zuò le hěn chǔn de shì.
english: I did something really stupid.

pinyin: wǒ méi xiǎng yào mào fàn nín.
english: I didn't mean to offend you.

pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu dǎ wǎng qiú.
english: She plays tennis every day.

chinese: 我想和她一起去看电影。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé tā yī qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng.
english: I'd like to go to the movies with her.

pinyin: wǒ wǎng qiú dǎ dī bù shì hěn hǎo.
english: I can't play tennis very well.

pinyin: yǒu rén jiù le wǒ de mìng.
english: Someone saved my life.

pinyin: nǐ de cè yàn zěn me yàng?
english: How was your test?

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng hé tā wán.
english: I don't want to play with him.

pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ de lǐ xiǎng qíng rén.
english: You're the girl of my dreams.

pinyin: wǒ men qù nián yù dào le chì zì.
english: We went into the red last year.

pinyin: wǒ dāng nǐ de dān bǎo rén.
english: I will be your guarantor.

chinese: 他希望抹去不好的记忆。
pinyin: tā xī wàng mǒ qù bù hǎo de jì yì.
english: He wishes to erase bad memories.

pinyin: zhè zhǒng cháng shì hěn huāng miù.
english: It's nonsense to try that.

pinyin: tā néng pǎo de hé wǒ yī yàng kuài.
english: He can run as fast as I can.

pinyin: nǐ xiǎng bǎ ěr duo lù chū lái ma?
english: Would you like your ears to show?

pinyin: bù yòng shuō, tā shì wú gū de.
english: It goes without saying that he is not guilty.

pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ wǎng qiú le ma?
english: Did you play tennis yesterday?

pinyin: wǒ hé tā yī qǐ zǒu.
english: He and I walked together.

chinese: 假若他在这里，他会说什么？
pinyin: jiǎ ruò tā zài zhè lǐ, tā huì shuō shén me?
english: If he were here, what would he say?

chinese: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
pinyin: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù.
english: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

chinese: 她比较鲁莽的相信了他。
pinyin: tā bǐ jiào lǔ mǎng de xiāng xìn le tā.
english: It was reckless of her to trust him.

pinyin: nǐ mēn le ma?
english: Are you getting bored?
